summary: Limitation period for IBC appeals; certified copy requirement; misrepresentation in grounds of appeal; condonation of delay; Section 61(2) IBC 30-day period; proviso 15-day extension; Section 12(3) Limitation Act; suppression of facts; appeals dismissed as barred by limitation; NCLAT order upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.60(5), s.35(1)(N), s.30(6), s.31(1), s.61
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; NCLAT order upheld; appeals barred by limitation.
